procedure: For each of 64 training courses, collect one independent frozen SONIC parent and three independent SIM_ONLY action arms, all 300 frames, four A6000 workers, strict physical and action replay audits. No batched causal labels.
reward: Measured clean first foot contact and 60-frame forward/lateral trajectory; out-of-play >4 m is a hard negative; pelvis <0.65 m is a hard negative.
model_selection: Train regularized causal-context option-value model using frame-30 measured state only. Compare to frozen training-fold best fixed arm in eight leave-one-seed-out folds. Permit one-shot seed 20260966 only if selected mean reward exceeds fixed in at least six folds, no selected out-of-play excess, and no loss of clean foot contact. Otherwise reject and diagnose.
